name: Barça Universal
description:
🚨 Barça expect a long summer market despite already presenting Anthony Gordon.

The club want to resolve priority signings before the World Cup, but several other operations depend on exits.

Players like Koundé, Balde, Casadó and Bardghji have interest from other clubs, and Barça could replace them if they leave.

— @mundodeportivo
